2123836786543862221.en_summary: Now that $ANT is trading here's how the lockup actually works. Only about 7% of Anthropic is public float. $SPCX floated about 4% in June and ran from $135 to $225 in three sessions. By late July it had lost about half its value from the peak before the first lock up even expired. Anthropic’s lock up is staged too and it started sooner. Employees and insiders could sell up to 315M shares.
